title: Support signed inline web review threads and suggestions

events.title: Support signed inline web review threads and suggestions
events.body:
## Outcome

Provide browser and command-line review conversations anchored to exact diff context, with signed suggestions and deterministic stale-state handling.

## Implementation

- Create signed line and range comment events bound to file, side, base object, head object, and patchset.
- Support replies, reactions, resolve, reopen, suggested changes, approval, and requested-change review states.
- Render anchors against current and historical patchsets and mark moved or missing context as stale without losing the thread.
- Allow authenticated browser submission through #446 and local command-line review through the same event schema.
- Fold concurrent replies, edits, resolution, and review-state changes through #440.

## Acceptance criteria

- Desktop, browser, and command-line clients render the same thread and current review state.
- Suggestions apply only when their base context and target bytes match.
- Patchset changes invalidate stale approvals and preserve historical anchors.
- Anonymous readers cannot mutate threads.
- Invalid, duplicate, replayed, or unauthorized events never enter the fold.

## Dependencies

Depends on #440 and #446; ownership and patchset navigation continue in #468.

## Verification

Exercise single-line, range, old-side, reply, edit, reaction, resolve/reopen, suggestion apply/reject, moved context, deleted file, duplicate, unauthorized, and shuffled-event fixtures.
